about_short_description.short_description: RedBox provides smart parcel lockers services to customers.

product.name: RedBox Express
product.description: A parcel delivery service using smart lockers for locker-to-locker or locker-to-door shipments within Saudi Arabia, offering 24/7 access and faster last-mile delivery.

product.name: Global Box (Shop & Ship from USA)
product.description: A service providing customers in Saudi Arabia with a US shipping address to shop online from US stores and receive parcels at local RedBox Points.

product.name: RedBox Storage
product.description: A locker rental service for secure, short-term storage of personal belongings at various locations in Saudi Arabia.

product.name: RedBox Return
product.description: A service enabling customers to return purchased items conveniently by dropping them off at RedBox smart lockers.

product.name: Host a Locker or Counter
product.description: A service for property managers and businesses to host RedBox lockers or counters at their locations to generate income and attract customers.

product.name: Locker as a Service (LaaS)
product.description: A service providing logistics providers with secure, efficient smart locker solutions to expand their delivery options.
